about: The parts of one whole as slices, largest first from 12 o'clock, each with its share written on it. A pie suits two to five parts.

browsers.about: maxSlices={4} renders the three largest browsers and gathers the other four into one slice named by otherLabel.
browsers.caption: Chrome brought 56% of the 10,490 sessions. The four smallest browsers brought 12% between them.
browsers.label: Sessions per browser
browsers.title: Long tail

largest.about: defaultIndex opens the tooltip at the largest slice when the chart first renders. The pointer or the arrow keys move it from slice to slice.
largest.caption: Starter's 610 customers are 47% of the 1,300.
largest.title: Tooltip

narrow.about: The plan mix in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone. The pie scales down with the room, and each share is written on its slice.
narrow.title: Narrow room

plans.about: Customers per plan, largest first from 12 o'clock, with each plan's share of the 1,300 written on its slice.
plans.caption: Starter has 47% of the 1,300 customers, Growth 40% and Scale 13%.
plans.label: Customers per plan
plans.title: Plan mix

quota.about: shares={false} leaves the slices unlabelled, for two parts whose figures the caption states. The tooltip writes each in gigabytes.
quota.caption: 142 GB of the 200 GB quota is in use.
quota.label: Storage quota in use
quota.title: Without shares

regions.about: valueOptions writes the tooltip's values in euros. The shares on the slices are of the whole revenue.
regions.caption: Europe brought €48,200, 46% of the €105,500 in revenue.
regions.label: Revenue per region
regions.title: Revenue by region

replay.about: animate grows the slices from 12 o'clock when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders the pie at once.
replay.title: Animation

survey.about: defaultHiddenKeys hides No answer on the first render, so the shares are of the 690 people who answered. A press on it in the legend shows it.
survey.caption: Of the 690 people who answered, 61% said yes.
survey.label: Answers to the renewal survey
survey.title: Hidden slice

title: Pie chart

unlaunched.about: A chart without slices renders the empty state in the plot's place, and no legend.
unlaunched.caption: Customers per plan.
unlaunched.title: Empty
